name: Bulgaria (presidential)
notes: President of Bulgaria: two-round election on 25 October 2026 (runoff 1 November). To win the first round a candidate needs 50% of the valid votes with turnout above 50%; a runoff otherwise, as every poll indicates. Iliana Iotova (the incumbent acting president, backed by Progressive Bulgaria and BSP) leads Andrey Gyurov (backed by PP-DB) with a runoff between them expected; the runoff map carries the 2021 runoff result (Radev 66.7 / Gerdzhikov 33.3).

turnout.source: Historical CIK presidential turnout; postmortem actual 21.91
